messages:
From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@medlane.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Forensics Team <forensics@medlane.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Request: temporary extension of log retention for active incident (MedLane)

Hi Jonas,

We have an active internal investigation tied to a production incident (ticket: ML-2025-612). Our forensics team needs access to raw request/response logs and associated request metadata for a rolling 90-day window covering 2025-12-20 -> 2026-03-20.

MedLane's standard retention is 30 days; for this investigation we need Redwood to:
- Place a temporary hold on deletion for the MedLane tenant so logs for the specified window are preserved,
- Confirm what data elements are included in retained logs (actor identifiers, timestamps, full request/response text, headers), and
- Confirm whether you can provide an export (SFTP or secure link) limited to the forensics team.

We anticipate needing the data for regulatory reporting and may require copies delivered to our E2E forensics environment. Attached is a short incident summary. Please also advise on timing, admin access restrictions, and any PO/legal paperwork you require.

Oliver
Oliver Grant
Security Lead, MedLane Health
oliver.grant@medlane.com

Attachment: MedLane-Incident-Overview.pdf

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@medlane.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary extension of log retention for active incident (MedLane)

Hi Oliver,

Thanks for the summary — and sorry to hear you have an active investigation. We can support a temporary retention hold for the MedLane tenant, but we need to confirm scope and complete a short agreement before enabling any extended retention. A few quick clarifying items: 

1) Exact retention window: you asked for 2025-12-20 -> 2026-03-20. Do you want us to backfill logs from 2025-12-20 or start the hold from the activation date and preserve forward for 90 days?
2) Data scope: Redwood stores request/response payloads, timestamps, and limited request metadata (IP truncation for some customers). We can produce a manifest of the fields included; I can attach that if useful.
3) Access method: we support SFTP export, secure SharePoint links, or scoped console export for named users. Exports will be limited to the forensics group you specify.
4) Legal/PO: our standard process requires a temporary log hold agreement signed by legal and a PO for any additional storage/operational cost if the hold exceeds baseline retention.

I've looped in Lauren from Ops to prepare the temporary hold template and cost estimate. If you can confirm the window and the forensics contact we'll draft the paperwork and scope.

Regards,
Jonas Weber
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai

Attachment: retention-hold-process.md

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@medlane.com>, Forensics Team <forensics@medlane.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Jan 2026 14:26:00 -08:00
Subject: Redwood — proposed temporary log hold (MedLane)

Hi Oliver / Forensics team,

Per Jonas' note, attached is Redwood's proposed temporary log hold agreement and a short operational checklist for exports. Key points:
- Scope: preserve raw request/response logs and request metadata for tenant medlane-prod for incident window 2025-12-20 -> 2026-03-20 (90 days). We will backfill to 2025-12-20 if the data is still available in cold storage; if not, we'll preserve from activation date plus 90 days.
- Access: exports will be available via SFTP to an IP allowlisted endpoint you provide, or via a secure SharePoint link; access limited to the named forensics users.
- Retention mechanics: we will mark objects with a temporary hold tag (log_hold_medlane_20260113) and disable automatic deletion pipelines for that tag.
- Cost: estimated incremental storage and export work is ~$1,200 (one-time) + ~$0.06/GB/month during the hold. Final invoice will follow PO acceptance.
- Termination: hold expires automatically at the end date unless extended by mutual agreement and signed amendment.

Next steps for MedLane to authorize:
1) Sign the attached redwood_temp_log_hold_agreement.pdf (DocuSign or signed scan acceptable),
2) Provide purchase order (PO) or billing approval to cover the incremental cost,
3) Confirm forensics contact email(s) and SFTP host details (if SFTP).

I attached a small log manifest showing the header fields we typically include so you can confirm sufficiency.

--
Lauren Bishop
Operations — Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood_temp_log_hold_agreement.pdf; access_instructions.txt; log_sample_manifest.csv
